title: identity thief
description: Identity Theft is a multiplayer Fabric mod. Killing another player temporarily steals their skin and visible username while granting combat and movement buffs. The disguise lasts 60 seconds.
body:
# 🕵️ Identity Theft

Identity Theft is a multiplayer Fabric mod that lets you temporarily steal another player’s identity after defeating them!

## ⚔️ What Happens After a Player Kill?

When you kill another player:
- 🎭 Your skin changes to the victim’s skin
- 🏷️ Your visible username changes to their username
- 💪 You receive temporary Strength
- ⚡ You receive temporary Speed
- ❤️ You receive short Regeneration
- ⏱️ A 60-second countdown appears on your screen
- 🔄 Killing someone else replaces your disguise and resets the timer
- ✨ Your original identity returns when the timer expires
  
## 🧠 Plan, Deceive and Confuse
This mod is perfect for creating clever strategies and confusing both friends and enemies!
Disguise yourself as another player to infiltrate teams, escape suspicion, mislead opponents, or surprise your friends. Multiple players can steal different identities simultaneously, creating unpredictable and exciting multiplayer encounters.

- 👥 Perfect For
- 🗡️ PvP servers
- 🏃 Manhunt challenges
- 🎭 Roleplay servers
- 🏰 Factions and team battles
- 🎮 Minigames
- 🧠 Social-deduction events
- 📦 Requirements

**Minecraft 1.21.1
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
Must be installed on the server and all participating clients**
